notes.title: Important Survival Mode Update
notes.notes:
Ahoy, me hearties! Thanks so much for all your support and patience while Aaron and I have been swabbing the poop deck and rigging the masts of the good ship Autonauts. It's almost time for us to weigh anchor, hoist the mainsail, and begin exploring the Bot Seas once again!

It's been quiet lately… too quiet, we know. BUT! There's been lots going on behind the scenes we can't share until everything's finalised for fear of jinxing it. We're not quite ready to announce everything we have coming up just yet, but what we can say is that 2022 is shaping up to be a big year for fans of Autonauts. 

However, ahead of all the good news we'll be announcing later on we felt it was important to update everyone about what's happening with the “Survival Mode” we promised as a free update for Autonauts a while back. The good news is that we have been working hard on it and it will be coming out soon, but the bad news is it isn’t going to be free.

Why's that? Well, in truth we didn't think this through. We expected to be spending a few months making it, but it's ended up taking us almost two years to finish. What started as "just an extra mode" for Autonauts has grown into an entirely new Autonauts experience of its own, because Aaron and I wanted to create the absolute best game we possibly could. At times it felt like we'd never finish it, but at last we see the end in sight. Now we're just a few more months away from finishing. We're both REALLY pleased with what we've made, and we're even more excited to share it with you all so you can enjoy playing it after waiting patiently for so long.

Of course, we do understand how deeply disappointed some of you will be that we won’t be able to bring new free content to the original Autonauts game for now, and we are genuinely sorry about that.  It's not a decision we've taken lightly, but there really is just the two of us making Autonauts and we miscalculated how much extra work it would take to create “Survival” mode. All our energy has gone into this new version, so we hope you understand and will continue to give us your support as we do our best to deliver the most amazing Autonauts experiences that the two of us possibly can.

We’ll be sharing more about the new Autonauts game in the coming months but in the meantime we wanted to assure all existing Autonauts players that we really appreciate the support you’ve given us so far. As a small token of that appreciation we’ve agreed with our publisher Curve that we will offer a discount to anyone who already owns the original Autonauts and wants to buy the new one when it launches - so not quite as free as we'd originally hoped, but still a whole lot of new Autonauting fun for as little as possible.

This has been a labour of love for our tiny team and we can't wait to share it with you all in just a few more short months.

notes.title: STEAM TRADING CARDS AND SURVIVAL MODE STATUS UPDATE
notes.notes:
PLEASE NOTE: This news post is outdated and Survival Mode has now changed, please see this post for more details: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/979120/view/3180113694795024770

Meanwhile, Aaron and I are still working hard on finishing off Survival Mode. It's fair to say there's more to do than we expected: a lot of unexciting but essential things like the presentation of information, but mainly resolving many niggling design issues and side effects. The main thing is, we're getting there :)

This week we added the first of the five 'boss' characters, namely 'Long Bot Silver'. To meet (and hopefully defeat) this ruby-eyed cutlass-rattling bag o' bones, you first need get them out of their hideaway (an old lighthouse), which means overthrowing relentless mechanical minions - and demolishing Pirate Barracks to halt production of said relentless mechanical minions.

Long Bot Silver controls a Twine Factory, which doesn't sound particularly exciting until you realise it's the only place to get essential string-making technology to manufacture slings and unlock ranged weapons. Without those, your units won't be taking out any flying Pirates any time soon, that's for sure.

Indispensable defence technology hoarded by the later bosses includes pitch (surprisingly useful sticky properties) and ultimately the game-changing combo of pesticide, fertiliser and charcoal.

The free Survival Mode expansion (which, TBH, is feeling more and more like 'Conquer Mode' every day) will be released... Well, as soon as we can possibly manage!

Stay safe! Stay Autonauty!

Gary and Aaron

notes.title: Cute colony building sim Autonauts enters Age of Enlightenment in final free update
notes.notes: Autonauts, developer Denki's automation-focussed colony management sim (complete with cute robots), has now entered the Age of Enlightenment, with this latest free update bringing the game's existing post-launch content roadmapto a close.The initial goal of Autonauts is simple enough: automate a band of adorable worker robots in order to make their new planetary home inhabitable for humans. Reaching that point, however, is considerably more challenging, requiring players to programme and manage their charges in order to first lay the groundwork for colonisation, then push their burgeoning civilisation to greater stages of advancement, unlocking new buildings, new transportation options, new tools, and new upgrades along the way.Autonauts' Age of Enlightenment marks the third and final phase of post-launch content updates originally announced last November (and the sixth free update in total), and is focussed on bringing culture to colonists' existence, enabling players to progress through the Art stage of the in-game evolution pyramid and reach true transcendence.Read more

notes.title: It's o-fish-al: Autonauts Update #5 'Aquanauts' is Live!
notes.notes:
Behold, ‘Aquanauts’! This month's Autonauts update sees the addition of even more bene-fish-ial updates to make automation even more e-fish-ient.

First off, our bots have had a little makeover. Old upgrades are now automatically removed once a newer one is implemented. Very handy. Plus, now much easier to work within the script limit when programming your bot, meaning your little team can be much more efficient. We've expanded the coding system, allowing not only the traditional REPEAT functions, but also brand new condition statements - including IF, IF/ELSE and EXIT REPEAT functions - giving you even more flexibility to code however you like.

Alongside improved bots are a bevy of new clothes, fishing updates and a beautiful new aquarium to top it all off. Take a peek at our latest trailer to see what else is on offer:

[previewyoutube=J4m0XpbJonI;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Autonauts enters the Industrial Age with a massive free update
notes.notes:
Today Denki and Curve Digital are set to launch their biggest update to date for their acclaimed coding and colonisation game, Autonauts. The free expansion, titled ‘The Industrial Revolution’, shifts the automation emphasis to mechanise the mining of coal and metal resources to build and fuel steam-powered worlds using potent new Mk 3 Bots. Players can now create advanced railroad networks with fully-functioning trains and add their own cheats, scripts and content to the game for the world to enjoy via Steam Workshop.

To see all the new content in this expansion, check out the fancy new trailer here:
[previewyoutube=W2lAERTfWr4;full]YOUTUBE[/previewyoutube]
Autonauts challenges players to colonise fertile alien worlds for the benefit of humanity with an array of robot helpers at their disposal. Utilising a visual programming language inspired by Scratch, players can playfully program their helpers to perform basic tasks like chopping down trees to more complicated duties like baking pies, fishing, powering-up other robots and lots more - all with the aim of satisfying colonists arriving from the homeworld. 

New Modding Support

 Players can now upload and download custom scripts, upgrades, buildings and other content to the game via Steam Workshop. 

New Train Networks

 For the first time players can build advanced rail networks and infrastructure to ferry goods and resources around their expanding colonies
 20 different new structures and 4 new core vehicles including Train Engine and multiple freight options

New Colonist Evolution

 Expand the evolution of your colonists with the addition of two entirely new categories on the in-game ‘Pyramid to Transcendance’: Health and Education. Make use of leeches and flowers to dispense medicinal aid to sick colonists and ensure they continue generating Wuv, and raise their undernourished intellect with books.

New Tools & Upgrades

 Steam Hammer
 Jacquard Power Loom
 Super Backpack to store more items
 Memory Upgrade so bots can perform more advanced routines
 Printing Press
 Paper Mill

New Housing

 Two-Storey Brick House and Mansion

Suitably Dickensian attire 

 Shirt and Tie, Coat and Scarf, Blazer and Cravat

New Toys

 Horse and Carriage
 Dollhouse

Hello all,

Please see below the Patch Notes for Version 128 of Autonauts.

This release has the first big research changes in it to help evolve Colonists from Level 3 to Level 4 more easily (sorry to all those valiantly struggling to do this). This involved moving a few researches around, changing some of their Wuv requirements as well as moving which objects are unlocked on which research. We've tried to be careful not to break anything. It may be that you were halfway through researching something but when you load up your level, it's already completed. This is normal as the thing you were researching probably now requires less Wuv. With all that said, here is the list:

Updated : Crude Toy Station no longer needs power.
Updated : Crude Toy Station no longer needs Box Frame to build.
Updated : Changed ingredients of Cauldron from Crude Metal Plate to Metal Ore, Clay and Crude Torch (and Sticks).
Updated : Moved Crude Data Storage to first Robotics research (from second) and it's now made on Crude Workbench (as well as Good Workbench). 
Fixed : A bot was able to change a workbench recipe when there were ingredients on it, and it shouldn't.
Fixed : Mousing over a converter while a bot changed the recipe would crash.
Fixed : Sometime loading a level would result in "item with save key already added -1" error.
Fixed : Clicking Max Area when adjusting a Sign's area didn't work.
Fixed : A Direction Sign's area couldn't be changed.
Fixed : Adding a Bee Nest to a Skep and moving it would leave an invisible bee behind that blocked building editing
Fixed : Bees going to a Flower pot would crash.
Fixed : Watering Cans can't take/add from a Barrel.
Fixed : Bots could sometimes not find objects or tiles

Phew! Still plenty of bugs to go but we're getting there :)

Many Thanks

Fixed : Sometimes and error would occur with TrailMaker.Update
Fixed : Highlighting a building as it's being built by a bot would crash
Fixed : Highlighting a blueprint, wait for it to be built by a bot, then move it would crash
Fixed : Finishing the first half of Mining Lesson, quitting the lesson then restarting, the lesson could not be completed.
Fixed : Pressing Stop wouldn't count as Bot Taught in the Robotics Certificate.
Fixed : Sometimes recharging a bot would crash
Fixed : Dragging something on the Inventory screen would reveal the Tutorial panel
Fixed : Sometimes using a Rocking Chair would crash
Fixed : Accessing a storage just after going into Edit Mode would crash
Fixed : It was possible to open the Wardrobe as something else was happening like completing research, making the game lock up.
Fixed : Sometimes levels won't load because "UID already exists"
Fixed : Bots sometimes get stuck after being given a new tool when one breaks.
Fixed : Script abuse results in a bot attempting to take something from an unknown object causing a crash.
Lots of other mysterious crashes with speculative fixes. Nice!

Thanks to everyone for your patience with this, sorry there isn't much interesting new stuff. There's been more than average bugs encountered and we're trying to deal with them as fast of possible. But keep the reports coming in! We'll get to the lovely stuff soon, promise!

notes.title: Autonauts Patch V126 Notes
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35498354/352578d3f11ea321015c35bf30184609fb60cbb1.png

Hello everyone,

Firstly, a big thank you to everyone who has been actively reporting issues and also sharing in our Discord channel! It helps us a lot.

From now on we're going to post news updates of patch notes moving forward so that we can keep everyone informed. Yesterday we launched V126 for Autonauts which fixed a lot of crash bugs that you were all experiencing. 

 Fixed : Editing bot names or group names would sometimes crash
 Fixed : Sometimes the Berries/Mushrooms tutorial would crash on the Objects screen
 Fixed : Teaching a bot to milk a cow and then giving it something other than a bucket would crash
 Fixed : Closing the inventory would sometimes crash
 Fixed : Moving buildings could sometimes crash
 Fixed : Teaching a bot to water Cereal with a bucket then giving it a Watering Can would crash.
 Fixed : RMB on a Cereal Crop with an empty bucket would crash
 Fixed : The Colonist Seed Dispenser Complete ceremony crashed 
 Fixed : Crash when moving a Research Station or completing a Research.
 Fixed : Moving a sign and seeing it in Inventory would crash.
 Fixed : Script abuse when applying a bot upgrade would crash.
 Lots of other mysterious crashes with speculative fixes :)

Version 127 is coming within the next day or two, so please keep on the lookout for that!

Many Thanks
